label: Moneybird
description: Send paid Swell orders and subscription invoices to Moneybird as invoices, register their payments, and book refunds as credit invoices. In Moneybird open Settings → Integrations → External applications → New API token, and give it access to sales invoices and settings.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the API token and administration, and lists the tax rates and financial accounts with their IDs

actions.label: Send existing orders
actions.hint: Sends paid orders that aren't in Moneybird yet

modal.title: Send existing orders
modal.description: Creates a Moneybird invoice for each paid order that the app hasn't sent yet, using the current settings, and registers its payment. Refunds made before aren't sent. Runs in the background; Moneybird allows about 30 orders every 5 minutes.

fields.label: API token
fields.description: Moneybird → Settings → Integrations → External applications → New API token, with access to sales invoices and settings

fields.label: Administration ID
fields.description: The number after moneybird.com/ in your Moneybird address. Leave empty and run Test connection to find it.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns off everything the app sends to Moneybird, without uninstalling it

fields.label: Book orders as
fields.description: Sales invoices get a Moneybird invoice number and can be emailed from Moneybird. External sales invoices only record the order, with the Swell order number.

fields.label: Send subscription invoices
fields.description: Books each paid subscription invoice (a renewal) the same way as an order, and its refunds as credit invoices

fields.label: New sales invoices
fields.description: Draft invoices have no number and aren't booked until you send them in Moneybird; their payment isn't registered.

fields.label: Workflow ID
fields.description: Optional. Moneybird → Settings → Workflows; empty uses your default invoice workflow.

fields.label: Document style ID
fields.description: Optional. Moneybird → Settings → Document styles; empty uses your default style.

fields.label: Default tax rate ID
fields.description: Optional. Each line gets the Moneybird sales tax rate with the percentage Swell charged; this rate is used when none matches. Test connection lists the IDs.

fields.label: Revenue ledger account ID
fields.description: Optional. Books all lines to this revenue account; empty uses Moneybird's default.

fields.label: Register payments
fields.description: Registers the Swell payment on the invoice, so it shows as paid

fields.label: Financial account ID
fields.description: Optional. The Moneybird account the payments arrive in, e.g. your payment provider's. Test connection lists the IDs.

fields.label: Payments without proof
fields.description: Registers payments as 'payment without proof'. Turn on 'Payments without proof' in Moneybird first.

fields.label: Send refunds
fields.description: Books each Swell refund as a credit invoice (or a negative external invoice) for the refunded amount

fields.label: Update contacts
fields.description: Each customer becomes a Moneybird contact with their first order. With this on, changes to the customer's name, email, phone, address or VAT number are sent to the contact.
